semantics.clock: Sample controls and data on each rising edge of clk; q updates after that edge with no extra pipeline stage.
semantics.priority: load=1 loads data regardless of ena; otherwise ena=01 rotates right, ena=10 rotates left, ena=00 or 11 holds.
semantics.reset_initialization: No reset port and no specified initial value. State becomes defined on a synchronous load.
semantics.between_edges: q remains unchanged between rising clock edges.

numeric.representation: 100-bit unsigned bit vector; all 100 bits retained
numeric.arithmetic: Bit permutation only; no arithmetic, rounding, saturation, sign extension or truncation.

verification.oracle: Independent per-bit modular-index reference, compared after each rising edge following first load.
verification.directed: All four enables with and without load; boundary bits; all-zero and all-one patterns; 100 consecutive rotations in each direction; alternating directions; walking one through every bit.
verification.random: Deterministic random data, controls, and repeated loads with scoreboard checks.
verification.timing: Check q holds when inputs change before the active edge and at the falling edge; use finite simulation and external tool timeouts.
verification.scope: Local development simulation only; no official evaluation, synthesis or board testing.

specification_ambiguities: Clock edge is not explicitly stated; conventional rising-edge sequential behavior is assumed.
Initial state and unknown control behavior are unspecified; no initialization or extra unknown-control behavior is required.
